# IF-003 — Create invoice

[Landscape and catalog](../../README.md) · [Catalog source](../../catalog/catalog.json)

Creates one invoice for an accepted order.

## Authentication

OAuth 2.0 client credentials; scope invoices:write.

## Reliability and failure handling

Send Idempotency-Key equal to orderId; retry transient errors using the same key.

## Integration notes

- Payment updates arrive separately via IF-004.
- This is an internal-to-external connection.
